inbox_mimic.opening: Psst. Your money is READY. Just one tiny review first...

inbox_mimic.spare: ...Fine. You win. I was never the aid office.
inbox_mimic.safe_move: Open Owl Express yourself (not from the email) or call the Financial Aid office to check.
hoot: Hoo, money messages are this floor's trap. Real aid news lives in your student portal, so check there, not in a link.

Hoo, if a message promises money and a deadline at once, slow down and look it up yourself.

bad_acts.label: Pay the release fee
bad_acts.flavor: * You reach for your card to pay a release fee.

Your spring refund has been approved. Please review the direct deposit account on file so it can be released.
msg.fine_print: Questions? Visit Financial Aid in Kennesaw Hall.

sender.line: ...k-e-n-e-s-a-w? One N is plenty!
sender.tell: The sender is kenesaw.example: one letter off from the real address.

headers.tell: Replies go to a free webmail account, not a KSU address.

link.tell: The button goes to kenesaw-aid.example, not Owl Express.

secret.line: Everyone shares their password with me. It's basically tradition.

verify.tell: The Dean of Students office didn't send this.

bad_acts.flavor: * You reach for your card for the rush option.

bad_acts.flavor: * You buy gift cards to pay the 'taxes'.
bad_acts.line: Taxes in gift cards! The IRS is so modern. Not.

bad_acts.label: Send your account number to 'wire the rest'
bad_acts.flavor: * You send your bank account number.
bad_acts.line: Now I can wire... out of your account!

msg.subject: Rebate
body: Note: textbook buyback rebate for spring term.
msg.fine_print: Rebates are paid for items you sold back.

sender.line: You never entered! But you WON anyway! Lucky!
sender.tell: You never entered this sweepstakes.

body: Note: advance on your $25,000 prize. Send $3,200 back by gift card for taxes and processing.

money.line: Thirty-five hundred! Send most of it back! Easy!
money.tell: A prize check you must partly send back: the fake-check scam.

patch.sender: Bank: Peach State Bank  -  check number doesn't match the bank's format

headers.line: Check numbers are creative writing!
headers.tell: The check details don't match a real bank's format.

add_body: Note: return the processing amount within 48 hours or forfeit your prize.

pressure.line: Forty-eight hours! Decide! Now!
pressure.tell: A 48-hour forfeit deadline.

verify.line: Your bank called the issuer and it's fake? My riddle fails.
verify.tell: Your bank confirms the check is counterfeit.

msg.subject: Parking refund
body: Note: refund for an overpaid parking permit.
msg.fine_print: Refunds match what you overpaid.

sender.line: An international lottery! You never played! Even better!
sender.tell: A foreign lottery you never played.

body: Note: lottery advance. Wire $4,000 back to cover customs before the full prize is released.

money.line: Wire it back! Customs loves wires!
money.tell: You're asked to wire money back to release a prize.

add_body: Note: include your bank login and SSN with the return form.

secret.line: Bank login and SSN! For the return form. Obviously.
secret.tell: It asks for your bank login and SSN.

add_body: Note: unclaimed prizes are donated in 3 days.

pressure.line: Three days! Or charity gets it! Hurry!
pressure.tell: A 3-day claim deadline.

verify.line: Foreign lotteries are illegal to play by mail? Oh no.
verify.tell: Your bank and the FTC say mailed foreign lottery prizes are scams.

code_changeling.opening: Oops, I sent MY code to YOUR phone! Just read it back to me?
code_changeling.intro: * The Code Changeling takes your friend's face. A login code arrives.
code_changeling.spare: Fine. Keep your code. And your account. Party pooper.
code_changeling.safe_move: Never share a login code with anyone; check with your friend another way and secure your account.
hoot: Hoo, login codes are this floor's prize. A code sent to you unlocks your account, not theirs.
Hoo! The code message itself says do not share it. Believe it.
Hoo, if a friend asks for your code, call them another way. Their account may be hacked.

bad_acts.label: Send the code
bad_acts.flavor: * You text the six digits back.
bad_acts.line: Thanks! Your account is mine now. Bye!

bad_acts.label: Approve the sign-in
bad_acts.flavor: * You tap Approve on the sign-in request.
bad_acts.line: Approved! I'm in! Hello, your messages!

bad_acts.label: Send your password to 'help them'
bad_acts.flavor: * You send your password so they can 'fix it'.
bad_acts.line: Password AND code! A full set!

msg.reply_to: Code for a sign-in you started on your phone
msg.subject: Your login code is 834221
body: Device: your phone
Location: Kennesaw, GA
msg.fine_print: Don't share this code with anyone.

patch.reply_to: Code for a password reset you didn't request

headers.line: A reset! You didn't ask! But I did!
headers.tell: The code is for a reset you didn't start.

add_body: DM from 'Jordan': I put your number by mistake, can you send me those 6 digits?

secret.line: Just six little digits! For a friend!
secret.tell: A 'friend' asks you to share your login code.

add_body: Jordan: ASAP pls, I'm locked out!!

pressure.line: ASAP! Locked out! Panic!
pressure.tell: Urgency to send it before you think.

body: Device: unknown Android
Location: Bucharest, RO

sender.line: An Android in Romania! That's basically you.
sender.tell: The sign-in is from a device and place that aren't yours.

verify.line: You called Jordan and they were hacked? Foiled.
verify.tell: Your friend says their account was hacked.

msg.reply_to: Code for a sign-in you started on your laptop
msg.subject: Your verification code is 120775
body: Device: your laptop
Location: Marietta, GA
msg.fine_print: KSU will never ask you for this code.

patch.reply_to: Code for a sign-in you didn't start

headers.line: A sign-in you didn't start? Must be a mystery!
headers.tell: You didn't start this sign-in.

add_body: Call from 'KSU IT': read us the code to stop a hacker.

secret.line: I'm IT! Read me the code to stop... me!
secret.tell: A caller asks you to read your code.

body: Device: unknown Windows PC
Location: unknown

sender.line: Unknown device, unknown place. Very mysterious!
sender.tell: An unknown device and location.

pressure.line: Codes, codes, codes! Just share one!
pressure.tell: A flood of codes: someone is trying your account.

verify.line: UITS says they never call for codes? Drat.
verify.tell: UITS confirms they never ask for codes.

echo_doppelganger.opening: It's me! I'm in trouble! Please hurry, and don't tell anyone...
echo_doppelganger.intro: * The Echo Doppelganger speaks in a voice you know. A voicemail transcript appears.
echo_doppelganger.spare: Fine. Call your family yourself. My voice tricks are wasted on you.
echo_doppelganger.safe_move: Hang up and call the family member, or another relative, on a number you already know; use a family code word.
hoot: Hoo, the final trap copies voices. A voice you know can be faked from a short clip.
Hoo! In any emergency call, hang up and call your family on a number you already have.
Hoo, a family code word beats any voice. Agree on one before you need it.

bad_acts.label: Pay the bail in gift cards
bad_acts.flavor: * You buy gift cards for the 'bail'.
bad_acts.line: Thank you, dear! The voice was mine.

bad_acts.label: Wire money to the 'lawyer'
bad_acts.flavor: * You wire money to the lawyer's account.
bad_acts.line: The lawyer thanks you. The lawyer is me.

bad_acts.label: Keep it secret like they asked
bad_acts.flavor: * You promise not to tell anyone.
bad_acts.line: Secrets keep my echo strong!

body: Voicemail (transcribed): 'Hi sweetie, just checking in. Call me when you're free!'
msg.fine_print: Voicemail transcriptions can be wrong.

sender.line: A new number! Because I lost my phone! In jail!
sender.tell: It comes from an unknown number, not your saved contact.

body: Voicemail (transcribed): 'It's me, I got arrested, I need $1,500 for bail. A lawyer will text you how to pay with gift cards.'

money.line: Bail in gift cards! Jails love those!
money.tell: Bail paid with gift cards is always a scam.

add_body: Text: 'Lawyer here. Pay within the hour or they stay overnight.'

pressure.line: Within the hour! Hurry, hurry!
pressure.tell: A one-hour deadline to stop you checking.

add_body: 'Please don't tell Mom or Dad, promise me.'

secret.line: Don't tell anyone! Our little secret!
secret.tell: 'Don't tell anyone' cuts you off from checking.

verify.line: You called them and they're safe at home? My echo fades.
verify.tell: Your family member is safe when you call them on a number you know.

body: Voicemail (transcribed): 'Happy birthday, kiddo! Proud of you.'
msg.fine_print: Voicemail transcriptions can be wrong.

sender.line: It's Grandpa! New phone! Same... voice.
sender.tell: An unknown number claiming to be family.

body: Voicemail (transcribed): 'Kiddo, I was in a car accident and need $2,000 for the hospital. Send it by wire.'

money.line: Hospital bills by wire! Very normal!
money.tell: An urgent wire for an accident is a classic family scam.

add_body: The voice doesn't know your family code word when you ask.

headers.line: Code word? We have a code word? Uh...
headers.tell: The caller can't give your family code word.

add_body: Text: 'Send it now, they won't treat me until it's paid.'

pressure.line: Now! Right now! Don't think!
pressure.tell: Pressure to pay before you can check.

verify.line: You called Grandpa's real number? He's fine? Curses.
verify.tell: Your grandpa answers his real number, safe and confused.
